title: Calling a Stored Closure
goal: Fix the trait bound and invocation syntax for a struct field closure.
hints: Rust separates method resolution from field lookup.
Wrap the field access in parentheses to evaluate the field before calling it, and specify the return type in the bound.
explanation: `(self.check)(val)` parenthesizes the field access so Rust evaluates `self.check` first and then invokes it as a function. Writing `self.check(val)` causes `E0599` because the compiler searches for a method named `check` on `Validator`. `Fn(i32) -> bool` specifies both argument and return types. Omitting `-> bool` defaults the expected return type to `()`, causing type mismatch `E0308`.
